raw.th: คุณแปลกใจกับสิ่งที่ปารีสทำ ก่อนน่านี้คุณยังไม่ได้สังเกตการเปลี่ยนแปลง แต่บัดนี้มันเด่นชัดแล้วว่า ปารีสนั้นมีภาระทางจิตใจที่น้อยลงกว่าเดิม
raw.vi: Ngươi ngạc nhiên trước các hành động của Paris. Ngươi đã loáng thoáng biết được sự thay đổi, nhưng giờ đây rõ ràng là Paris đã thoải mái tinh thần hơn trước đó.

id: Menuju Puing, mencari Seria dan Lugina. Paris tidak ada di sini, dan berjalan di belakang Mora yang diam saja terasa tidak benar.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_10141_DESCRIPTION
desc: You head towards the Ruins in search of Seria and Lugina. Now that Paris is not around, walking behind the silent Mora doesn't feel right.

raw.en: You head towards the Ruins in search of Seria and Lugina. Now that Paris is not around, walking behind the silent Mora doesn't feel right.
raw.es: Te diriges hacia las ruinas en busca de Seria y Lugina. Ahora que Paris no está, caminar detrás de la silenciosa Mora no es muy cómodo que digamos.
raw.id: Menuju Puing, mencari Seria dan Lugina. Paris tidak ada di sini, dan berjalan di belakang Mora yang diam saja terasa tidak benar.
raw.pt: Você avança na direção das ruínas em busca de Seria e Lugina. Agora que a Paris não está por perto, não parece certo seguir a silenciosa Mora.
raw.th: คุณมุ่งหน้าไปยังซากปรักเพื่อตามหาซีเรียและลูจิน่า ตอนนี้ปารีสไม่อยู่ด้วยแล้ว การอยู่ด้านหลังโมร่าที่เอาแต่นิ่งเงียบนั้นทำให้รู้สึกไม่ค่อยดี
raw.vi: Ngươi hướng về phía Tàn tích để tìm kiếm Seria và Lugina. Giờ thì Paris không có ở bên, đi sau thần Mora yên lặng không mang lại cảm giác an toàn.

id: Ada firasat buruk. Kehendak jahat murni yang haus darah dan tajam semakin dekat. Tidak ada jalan untuk lari, jadi bersiaplah balas menyerang.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_10142_DESCRIPTION
desc: A bad feeling overcomes you. A sharp, blood thirsty will made of pure evil draws near. There's nowhere to run, so prepare a good counterattack.

raw.en: A bad feeling overcomes you. A sharp, blood thirsty will made of pure evil draws near. There's nowhere to run, so prepare a good counterattack.
raw.es: Una mala sensación se apodera de ti. Una fuerte voluntad sedienta de sangre y poder puro se acerca. No hay escapatoria. Prepara un buen contraataque.
raw.id: Ada firasat buruk. Kehendak jahat murni yang haus darah dan tajam semakin dekat. Tidak ada jalan untuk lari, jadi bersiaplah balas menyerang.
raw.pt: Um mau pressentimento toma conta de você. Uma vontade afiada e sanguinária, se aproxima com maldade pura. Não há para onde fugir, então é melhor montar um bom contra-ataque.
raw.th: ความรู้สึกไม่ดีบังเกิดขึ้น สิ่งชั่วร้ายที่แข็งแกร่งและกระหายเลือดรออยู่ไม่ไกล ไม่มีทางหนีแล้ว ต้องเตรียมตัวจู่โจมอย่างดี
raw.vi: Một cảm giác tồi tệ xâm chiếm lấy ngươi. Một cơn khát máu sẽ khiến con quái vật tiến đến gần hơn. Chẳng còn nơi nào để chạy trốn, nên hãy chuẩn bị tốt cho cuộc hỗn chiến.

id: Sejauh mana Paris pergi? Tidak ada kehadiran siapa pun di sekitarmu, tapi apa pun yang akan kau temui tidaklah lemah. Paling baik, berkumpul lagi.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_10143_DESCRIPTION
desc: Just how far did Paris go? You can't pick up any presences around you, but whatever you encounter will not be weak. It would be good to regroup.

raw.en: Just how far did Paris go? You can't pick up any presences around you, but whatever you encounter will not be weak. It would be good to regroup.
raw.es: ¿Qué tan lejos se fue Paris? No sientes ninguna presencia cerca, pero lo que te encuentres, seguro será fuerte. Sería bueno reagruparse.
raw.id: Sejauh mana Paris pergi? Tidak ada kehadiran siapa pun di sekitarmu, tapi apa pun yang akan kau temui tidaklah lemah. Paling baik, berkumpul lagi.
raw.pt: Até onde a Paris foi? Você não detecta presenças ao seu redor, mas seja o que encontrar, não vai ser fraco. Seria melhor reagrupar.
raw.th: ปารีสไปไกลแค่ไหนแล้ว? คุณไม่อาจหยิบสิ่งของรอบๆ ได้ แต่หากคุณตอบโต้ได้ดีพอสมควร ก็ยังพอจะกลับมารวมกลุ่มกันได้
raw.vi: Paris đã đi bao xa rồi? Ngươi không thể tìm được sự hiện diện nào quanh mình, thế nhưng bất kể những gì người gặp phải đều sẽ chẳng hề yếu ớt. Sẽ tốt hơn nếu gộp thành nhóm.

id: Semua berlangsung cepat, tidak ada waktu untuk bereaksi. Apa yang dipikirkan Mora? Tidak ada waktu untuk merenung soal itu juga.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_10144_DESCRIPTION
desc: Things are happening so suddenly, there is no time to react. What could Mora be thinking? There's no time to ponder about that either.

raw.en: Things are happening so suddenly, there is no time to react. What could Mora be thinking? There's no time to ponder about that either.
raw.es: Las cosas pasan tan de prisa que no hay tiempo para reaccionar. ¿En qué pensará Mora? Tampoco tienes tiempo para ponderar eso.
raw.id: Semua berlangsung cepat, tidak ada waktu untuk bereaksi. Apa yang dipikirkan Mora? Tidak ada waktu untuk merenung soal itu juga.
raw.pt: As coisas aconteceram tão de repente, que não há tempo de reagir. O que Mora está pensando? Mas não há tempo para se preocupar com isso.
raw.th: ทุกสิ่งเกิดขึ้นอย่างรวดเร็ว ไม่มีเวลาให้ตอบโต้ โมร่ากำลังคิดอะไรอยู่? ไม่มีเวลาให้คิดแล้ว
raw.vi: Mọi thứ xảy ra quá đột ngột, không có lấy thời gian để phản ứng. Thần Mora có thể suy nghĩ gì nhỉ? Cũng chẳng còn thời gian để suy nghĩ đến điều đó.

id: Setelah terpisah lama, kau bersatu kembali dengan Seria dan Lugina. Kini kau harus memulai semua persiapan untuk menghadapi Mora sekali lagi.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_10150_DESCRIPTION
desc: After being apart for such a long time, you reunite with Seria and Lugina. Now you must begin all preparations necessary to face Mora once again.

raw.en: After being apart for such a long time, you reunite with Seria and Lugina. Now you must begin all preparations necessary to face Mora once again.
raw.es: Después de tanto tiempo, te reúnes con Seria y Lugina. Ahora deben comenzar los preparativos para enfrentar a Mora una vez más.
raw.id: Setelah terpisah lama, kau bersatu kembali dengan Seria dan Lugina. Kini kau harus memulai semua persiapan untuk menghadapi Mora sekali lagi.
raw.pt: Depois de tanto tempo separados, você se reúne a Seria e Lugina. Agora você precisa começar os preparativos para enfrentar Mora novamente.
raw.th: หลังจากแยกกันไปพักหนึ่ง ก็ได้กลับมารวมกลุ่มกับซีเรียและลูจิน่า ตอนนี้สามารถเตรียมสิ่งที่จำเป็นสำหรับการเผชิญหน้ากับโมร่ได้แล้ว
raw.vi: Sau khi xa cách một thời gian dài, ngươi gặp lại Seria và Lugina. Bây giờ ngươi phải bắt đầu mọi sự chuẩn bị cần thiết để đối mặt với Mora một lần nữa.

id: Batu hitam dan lava merah mengingatkanmu akan gua pertama yang kau lewati. Tidak sepanas itu di sini, tapi miasma mengerikannya tak tertahankan.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_10151_DESCRIPTION
desc: The black rocks and red lava remind you of the first caverns you passed through. It's not that hot here, but you're thrown off by the ominous miasma.

raw.en: The black rocks and red lava remind you of the first caverns you passed through. It's not that hot here, but you're thrown off by the ominous miasma.
raw.es: Las rocas negras y la lava roja te recuerdan a las cavernas que ya pasaste. Aquí no hace tanto calor, pero el miasma ominoso te confunde.
raw.id: Batu hitam dan lava merah mengingatkanmu akan gua pertama yang kau lewati. Tidak sepanas itu di sini, tapi miasma mengerikannya tak tertahankan.
raw.pt: As pedras negras e a lava vermelha lembram você do primeiro complexo de cavernas por onde passou. Não é tão quente aqui, mas você se sente mal com o miasma funesto.
raw.th: หินสีดำและลาวาสีแดงทำให้นึกถึงถ้ำแรกที่ผ่านมา ที่นี่ไม่ค่อยร้อนนัก แต่ก็สัมผัสได้ถึงกลิ่นอายอันชั่วร้าย
raw.vi: Những mỏm đá đen ngòm và dòng nham thạch đỏ gợi ngươi nhớ đến hang động đầu tiên đã đi qua. Nơi đây không nóng như chỗ đó, nhưng ngươi bị tấn công bởi chướng khí sặc mùi quái vật.

id: Firasat buruk lagi. Kau sudah merasakan ini banyak kali sekarang, niat jahat untuk membunuh. Ditambah miasma, bulu kuduk berdiri.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_10152_DESCRIPTION
desc: A bad feeling once again. You've felt this countless times by now, this evil intent to kill. And combined with the miasma, chills run down your spine.

raw.en: A bad feeling once again. You've felt this countless times by now, this evil intent to kill. And combined with the miasma, chills run down your spine.
raw.es: Otra mala sensación. Has sentido esto incontables veces, este mal decidido a matar, que combinado con el miasma, te pone los pelos de punta.
raw.id: Firasat buruk lagi. Kau sudah merasakan ini banyak kali sekarang, niat jahat untuk membunuh. Ditambah miasma, bulu kuduk berdiri.
raw.pt: Outro mau pressentimento. Você já sentiu isso muitas vezes: maldade com intenção de matar. Junto do miasma, isso te dá arrepios.
raw.th: ความรู้สึกไม่ดีบังเกิดอีกครั้ง ตอนนี้มันเกิดขึ้นนับครั้งไม่ถ้วนแล้ว สิ่งชั่วร้ายนี้ต้องการจะฆ่าคุณ รวมทั้งกลิ่นอายอันชั่วร้ายนั้น ทำให้รู้สึกหนาวไปถึงกระดูก
raw.vi: Lại thêm một cảm giác tồi tệ nữa. Người vừa cảm giác thời gian như bất tận, quái vật này đang tính giết ngươi. Và cùng với chướng khí, cơn lạnh buốt chạy dọc sống lưng ngươi.

id: Saat menoleh ke belakang, sepertinya semua tanah diterangi petir. Mungkin itu penderitaan si naga. Jembatan panjang berdiri di depan.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_10153_DESCRIPTION
desc: When you look behind you, it seems as if all the land were illuminated by lightning. Perhaps it's the dragon's suffering. A long bridge stands ahead.

raw.en: When you look behind you, it seems as if all the land were illuminated by lightning. Perhaps it's the dragon's suffering. A long bridge stands ahead.
raw.es: Cuando miras hacia atrás, parece que la electricidad iluminara toda la tierra. Quizá sea el sufrimiento del dragón. Delante de ti, ves un gran puente.
raw.id: Saat menoleh ke belakang, sepertinya semua tanah diterangi petir. Mungkin itu penderitaan si naga. Jembatan panjang berdiri di depan.
raw.pt: Quando você olha para trás, é como se tudo fosse iluminado por um raio. Talvez seja o sofrimento do dragão. Uma ponte longa se ergue à sua frente.
raw.th: เมื่อมองไปข้างหลัง ดูเหมือนทั้งดินแดนจะถูกแสงทำให้ลวงตา หรือนี่คือความทุกข์ทนของมังกร อย่างไรก็ตาม สะพานทอดยาวตั้งตระหง่านอยู่ข้างหน้าแล้ว
raw.vi: Khi ngươi quay lại nhìn, dường như tất cả vùng đất rực sáng bởi các tia chớp. Có lẽ đó là nỗi đau của con rồng. Một chiếc cầu dài bắc dọc theo đó.

id: Setelah menuruni bukit curam, kau semakin dekat dengan jembatan besar. Miasma di sekitarmu membuat semua lebih mengerikan karena menunjuk ke musuh.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_10154_DESCRIPTION
desc: After climbing down a steep hill, you grow closer to the great bridge. The miasma around you makes everything creepier as it points towards the enemy.

raw.en: After climbing down a steep hill, you grow closer to the great bridge. The miasma around you makes everything creepier as it points towards the enemy.
raw.es: Luego de bajar una por ladera, te acercas al gran puente. El miasma que te rodea hace que todo se vea más escalofriante. El enemigo está cerca.
raw.id: Setelah menuruni bukit curam, kau semakin dekat dengan jembatan besar. Miasma di sekitarmu membuat semua lebih mengerikan karena menunjuk ke musuh.
raw.pt: Depois de descer uma colina íngreme, você chega mais perto da grande ponte. O miasma à sua volta torna tudo mais assustador, apontando para o inimigo.
raw.th: หลังข้ามเนินขาอันสูงชันมาได้ ก็เริ่มเข้าใกล้สะพานขนาดใหญ่แล้ว ไอพิษรอบๆ เหมือนจะนำทางไปหาศัตรูได้
raw.vi: Sau khi leo lên ngọn đồi dốc, người tiến gần đến cây cầu lớn. Chướng khí xung quanh ngươi làm mọi thứ càng thêm rùng rợn khi ngày càng gần kẻ thù.

id: Setan Mora akhirnya menunjukkan identitas aslinya. Ia bilang jika kau ingin tahu di mana Karl, kau harus mengalahkannya dulu. Apa dia bisa dipercaya?
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_10160_DESCRIPTION
desc: The demon Mora finally reveals her true identity. She says that if you wish to know Karl's whereabouts, you must defeat her first. Can you trust her?

raw.en: The demon Mora finally reveals her true identity. She says that if you wish to know Karl's whereabouts, you must defeat her first. Can you trust her?
raw.es: Mora finalmente revela su verdadera identidad. Dice que si quieres saber dónde está Karl, primero deberás derrotarla. ¿Puedes confiar en ella?
raw.id: Setan Mora akhirnya menunjukkan identitas aslinya. Ia bilang jika kau ingin tahu di mana Karl, kau harus mengalahkannya dulu. Apa dia bisa dipercaya?
raw.pt: A demônio Mora finalmente revela sua identidade. Ela disse que se quer descobrir onde está o Karl, precisa derrotá-la. Será que dá para confiar nisso?
raw.th: ปีศาจโมร่าปรากฎร่างแท้จริงออกมา เธอบอกว่าหากอยากรู้ง่าคาร์ลอยู่ที่ไหน ก็ต้องกำจัดเธอก่อน จะเชื่อใจเธอได้ไหม?
raw.vi: Quái vật Mora cuối cùng xuất hiện với đúng hiện thân của nó. Ả nói nếu muốn biết tung tích của Karl, ngươi phải đánh bại ả ta trước. Ngươi có tin lời ả ta không?

id: Menyeberangi jembatan besar dengan Lugina mengingatkanmu akan masa-masa di Lizeria. Kau ingin tahu bagaimana hubunganmu sejauh ini.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_10161_DESCRIPTION
desc: Crossing the great bridge with Lugina reminds you of your time in Lizeria. With that in mind you wonder how your relationship has made it this far.

raw.en: Crossing the great bridge with Lugina reminds you of your time in Lizeria. With that in mind you wonder how your relationship has made it this far.
raw.es: Al cruzar el gran puente con Lugina, recuerdas tus épocas en Lizeria. Con eso en mente, te preguntas cuánto ha evolucionado la amistad hasta hoy.
raw.id: Menyeberangi jembatan besar dengan Lugina mengingatkanmu akan masa-masa di Lizeria. Kau ingin tahu bagaimana hubunganmu sejauh ini.
raw.pt: Cruzar a grande ponte com Lugina lembra você de sua jornada em Lizeria. Com isso em mente, você pondera sobre onde seu relacionamento chegou.
raw.th: การข้ามสะพานมาด้วยกันกับลูจิน่าทำให้นึกถึงเมื่อครั้งอยู่ที่ลิเซอร์เรีย ไม่น่าเชื่อว่าความสนิทสนมของคุณและลูจิน่าจะมาได้ถึงขนาดนี้
raw.vi: Băng qua cây cầu lớn cùng Lugian làm ngươi nhớ đến khoảng thời gian ở Lizeria. Lâng lâng với những suy nghĩ khiến ngươi tự hỏi liệu mối quan hệ của ngươi đã tiến xa như thế này chưa.

id: Berkat bantuan Paris dan Lugina, kau takkan menghadapi banyak jebakan sepanjang jalan. Tapi setan-setan kiriman Mora datang tiada henti.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_10162_DESCRIPTION
desc: Thanks to Paris and Lugina's help, you won't face many traps along the way. But the demons Mora has sent come at you one after another.

raw.en: Thanks to Paris and Lugina's help, you won't face many traps along the way. But the demons Mora has sent come at you one after another.
raw.es: Gracias a Paris y la ayuda de Lugina, no te toparás con tantas trampas en el camino. Pero los demonios que envió Mora vienen hacia ti.
raw.id: Berkat bantuan Paris dan Lugina, kau takkan menghadapi banyak jebakan sepanjang jalan. Tapi setan-setan kiriman Mora datang tiada henti.
raw.pt: Graças à ajuda de Paris e Lugina, você não vai enfrentar muitas armadilhas. Mas os demônios enviados por Mora vêm um atrás do outro.
raw.th: ต้องขอบคุณการช่วยเหลือจากได้ปารีสและลูจิน่า ทำให้คุณไม่ต้องเจอกับดักมากมายตามเส้นทาง แต่ปีศาจที่โมร่าได้ส่งมาหาคุณนั้นไม่มีหยุดหย่อนเลย
raw.vi: Nhờ sự trợ giúp của Paris và Lugina, ngươi sẽ không phải đối mặt với những cạm bẫy trên hành trình. Thế nhưng quái vật Mora cứ thế từng con xuất hiện trước mặt ngươi.

id: Kau mungkin sudah mengalahkan murid, tapi hawanya tidak lenyap total. Setan-setan mirip si murid mengejarmu, tapi kau baru separuh jalan.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_10163_DESCRIPTION
desc: You may have beaten a disciple, but its presence is not completely gone. Countless disciple-like demons come after you, but you're only halfway there.

raw.en: You may have beaten a disciple, but its presence is not completely gone. Countless disciple-like demons come after you, but you're only halfway there.
raw.es: Quizá hayas vencido a una discípula, pero su presencia sigue allí. Los demonios cuasi discípulos te siguen, pero ya has recorrido la mitad del camino.
raw.id: Kau mungkin sudah mengalahkan murid, tapi hawanya tidak lenyap total. Setan-setan mirip si murid mengejarmu, tapi kau baru separuh jalan.
raw.pt: Você pode ter acabado com um discípulo, mas sua presença não se foi. Incontáveis demônios parecidos com discípulos estão atrás de você, mas você ainda está na metade do caminho.
raw.th: คุณอาจกำจัดศิษย์ของลูเซียสได้ แต่ร่างของมันไม่ได้หายไปอย่างสิ้นเชิง ปีศาจที่เหมือนจะเป็นศิษ์ของลูเซียสปรากฎตัวนับไม่ถ้วน แต่คุณก็มาได้ครึ่งทางแล้ว
raw.vi: Ngươi sẽ bị đánh bại bởi một môn đồ, thế nhưng sự hiện diện của hắn hoàn toàn biến mất. Môn đồ không đếm xuể - từ những quái vật lởn vởn quanh ngươi, nhưng ngươi chỉ mới đi được một nửa chặng đường.

id: Perang terus, tapi saat berperang, kau merasakan kekuatan aneh dan baru sedang mendekat. Tapi rasanya familier...
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_10164_DESCRIPTION
desc: It's battle after battle, but while caught up in them you feel a new,  yet strange power approaching. It feels familiar somehow though...

raw.en: It's battle after battle, but while caught up in them you feel a new,  yet strange power approaching. It feels familiar somehow though...
raw.es: Es una batalla tras otra. Mientras las superas una a una, sientes que un nuevo poder se acerca. De alguna forma, sientes que lo conoces...
raw.id: Perang terus, tapi saat berperang, kau merasakan kekuatan aneh dan baru sedang mendekat. Tapi rasanya familier...
raw.pt: Batalha após batalha, envolvido nelas você sente um novo poder se aproximando. Ele parece estranhamente familiar...
raw.th: นี่คือสงครามหลังสงคราม แต่ขณะที่ตกอยู่ในกลุ่มพวกมันก็รู้สึกถึงพลังใหม่ พลังอันแปลกประหลาดกำลังใกล้เข้ามา ช่างเหมือนกับ...
raw.vi: Hết trận này đến trận khác, nhưng khi đuổi theo chúng ngươi bỗng cảm thấy một luồng sức mạnh vừa kỳ lạ vừa mới mẻ ập đến. Lại vừa quen thuộc mặc dù…

id: Setelah mengalahkan Shusui, kau pergi menuju akhir jembatan. Namun ada hawa setan itu lagi. Kau tahu setan mana yang menunggu sekarang.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_10165_DESCRIPTION
desc: After defeating Shusui anew, you head towards the end of the bridge. However, you feel that demonic presence again. You know which demon awaits now.

raw.en: After defeating Shusui anew, you head towards the end of the bridge. However, you feel that demonic presence again. You know which demon awaits now.
raw.es: Tras derrotar a Shusui, te diriges al final del puente. Sin embargo, vuelves a sentir la presencia demoniaca. Ya sabes qué demonio te espera.
raw.id: Setelah mengalahkan Shusui, kau pergi menuju akhir jembatan. Namun ada hawa setan itu lagi. Kau tahu setan mana yang menunggu sekarang.
raw.pt: Depois de derrotar Shusui novamente, você continua em direção à saída da ponte. Mas você sente a presença demoníaca novamente. Você sabe qual demônio aguarda dessa vez.
raw.th: หลังจากกำจัดชูซูอิลงอีกครั้ง ก็มุ่งหน้าไปยังสุดทางของสะพาน อย่างไรก็ตาม คุณรู้สึกว่าปีศาจจะปรากฎตัวอีกครั้ง คุณรู้ดีว่ามันรออยู่
raw.vi: Sau khi đánh bại Shusui một lần nữa, ngươi đi thẳng đến cuối cây cầu. Tuy nhiên, ngươi lại cảm nhận được sự hiện diện của quái vật. Ngươi biết con quái vật nào đang đợi mình.

id: Setan Mora tiba-tiba muncul di depanmu lagi. Apa itu bayangan setan? Dan apa yang terjadi di Ishgria?
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_10170_DESCRIPTION
desc: The demon Mora suddenly appears before you again. What is a demon's shadow? And just what could be going on in Ishgria?

raw.en: The demon Mora suddenly appears before you again. What is a demon's shadow? And just what could be going on in Ishgria?
raw.es: De repente, la demonio Mora vuelve a posarse frente a ti. ¿Qué es la sombra de un demonio? ¿Y qué es lo que ocurre en Ishgria?
raw.id: Setan Mora tiba-tiba muncul di depanmu lagi. Apa itu bayangan setan? Dan apa yang terjadi di Ishgria?
raw.pt: A demônio Mora aparece à sua frente, de novo. O que é a sombra de um demônio? E o que, exatamente, está acontecendo em Ishgria?
raw.th: ปีศาจโมร่าปรากฎตัวต่อหน้าคุณอีกครั้ง นี่คือเงาของมันรึ? แล้วอิชเกรียจะเป็นยังไงกันนะ?
raw.vi: Quái vật Mora đột nhiên xuất hiện trước mắt ngươi một lần nữa. Bóng con quái vật là thứ gì vậy? Và chuyện gì có thể xảy ra tiếp theo tại Ishgria?

id: Kuil Terang, katanya adalah tempat lahir kekuatan hebat. Pemula lebih baik tidak masuk.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_100305_DESCRIPTION
desc: The Temple of Light, said to be the birthplace of an incredible power. Novices would be wise not to enter.

raw.en: The Temple of Light, said to be the birthplace of an incredible power. Novices would be wise not to enter.
raw.es: El templo de trueno, el cual se dice es origen de un increíble poder. Será mejor que novatos no entren.
raw.id: Kuil Terang, katanya adalah tempat lahir kekuatan hebat. Pemula lebih baik tidak masuk.
raw.pt: O Templo da Luz, acredita-se que seja o local de origem de um poder incrível. Não entrar seria uma decisão inteligente para novatos.
raw.th: วิหารแห่งแสงนี้ว่ากันว่าเป็นแหล่งกำเนิดพลังอันน่ามหัศจรรย์ นักรบฝึกหัดไม่ควรจะเข้าไป
raw.vi: Ngôi đền Ánh sáng, được tin rằng là nơi sinh ra những quyền năng kỳ diệu. Những người mới tới sẽ không dám bước vào.

id: Kuil Gelap, katanya adalah tempat lahir kekuatan hebat. Pemula lebih baik tidak masuk.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_100306_DESCRIPTION
desc: The Temple of Dark, said to be the birthplace of an incredible power. Novices would be wise not to enter.

raw.en: The Temple of Dark, said to be the birthplace of an incredible power. Novices would be wise not to enter.
raw.es: El templo de la oscuridad, el cual se dice es origen de un increíble poder. Será mejor que novatos no entren.
raw.id: Kuil Gelap, katanya adalah tempat lahir kekuatan hebat. Pemula lebih baik tidak masuk.
raw.pt: O Templo da Sombra, acredita-se que seja o local de origem de um poder incrível. Não entrar seria uma decisão inteligente para novatos.
raw.th: วิหารแห่งแสงนี้ว่ากันว่าเป็นแหล่งกำเนิดพลังอันน่ามหัศจรรย์ นักรบฝึกหัดไม่ควรจะเข้าไป
raw.vi: Ngôi đền Bóng tối, được tin là nơi sinh ra những quyền năng kỳ diệu. Những người mới tới sẽ không dám bước vào.

id: Pintu masuk surga hanya terbuka sehari sekali. Berbagai jenis kuakan terdengar dari luar...
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_110000_DESCRIPTION
desc: This entrance to the heavens opens only once a day. Multiple kinds of croaking can be heard from outside...

raw.en: This entrance to the heavens opens only once a day. Multiple kinds of croaking can be heard from outside...
raw.es: La entrada a los cielos se abre solo una vez al día. Se escuchan los cánticos de los sapos desde fuera...
raw.id: Pintu masuk surga hanya terbuka sehari sekali. Berbagai jenis kuakan terdengar dari luar...
raw.pt: Essa entrada aos céus só abre uma vez por dia. Vários tipos de coachar podem ser ouvidos do lado de fora...
raw.th: ทางเข้าสู่สวรรค์จะเปิดเพียงวันละครั้ง และจะได้ยินเสียงร้องต่างๆ ดังมาจากด้านนอก...
raw.vi: Lối vào thiên giới này chỉ mở một lần mỗi ngày. Nhiều tiếng kêu rền rĩ đủ các loại có thể nghe được từ bên ngoài...

id: Kau hanya bisa masuk Taman Imp sehari sekali. Makhluk-makhluk kecil memanggil inang untuk fusi...
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_110001_DESCRIPTION
desc: You can only enter the Garden of Imps once a day. Little creatures are calling for a host to fuse with...

raw.en: You can only enter the Garden of Imps once a day. Little creatures are calling for a host to fuse with...
raw.es: Solo puedes entrar al Jardín de diablillos una vez al día. Las pequeñas criaturas buscan a un huésped con quien fusionarse...
raw.id: Kau hanya bisa masuk Taman Imp sehari sekali. Makhluk-makhluk kecil memanggil inang untuk fusi...
raw.pt: Você só pode entrar no Jardim de Diabretes uma vez ao dia. Pequenas criaturas estão clamando por um hospedeiro para fusão...
raw.th: คุณสามารถเข้าไปยังการ์เดน ออฟ อิมป์ได้เพียงวันละครั้ง สิ่งมีชีวิตตัวเล็กๆ นั้นกำลังเรียกหาร่างที่จะฟิวชั่นด้วย...
raw.vi: Ngươi chỉ có thể vào Vườn Tiểu Quỷ một lần mỗi ngày. Những sinh vật bé nhỏ đang tìm vật chủ để hợp nhất...

id: Selama perang besar dengan para dewa, Palmyna terkena invasi pasukan Cardes si Keji. Kerajaan menghadapi bahaya, Putri Edea dengan zirah bermantranya, Lafranya, pergi untuk menemui temannya Lorand, Loch, dan Dean. Bersama, mereka bergabung dengan pasukan kerajaan menuju perang terakhir.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_5000008_DESCRIPTION
desc: During the great war with the gods, Palmyna suffers an invasion from the troops led by Cardes the Malevolent. With the kingdom facing a terrible danger, Princess Edea dons the enchanted armor Lafdranya and sets off on a journey to meet companions Lorand, Loch, and Dean. Together they join the rest of the royal army and head towards the last battle.

raw.en: During the great war with the gods, Palmyna suffers an invasion from the troops led by Cardes the Malevolent. With the kingdom facing a terrible danger, Princess Edea dons the enchanted armor Lafdranya and sets off on a journey to meet companions Lorand, Loch, and Dean. Together they join the rest of the royal army and head towards the last battle.
raw.es: Durante la gran guerra contra los dioses, Palmyna sufre una invasión a manos de las tropas lideradas por Cardes el Malévolo. El reino enfrenta un peligro terrible. La princesa Edea se viste con la armadura encantada Lafdranya y se embarca en una aventura para encontrarse con sus compañeros Lorand, Loch y Dean. Juntos, se unen al resto del ejército real y se dirigen a la última batalla.
raw.id: Selama perang besar dengan para dewa, Palmyna terkena invasi pasukan Cardes si Keji. Kerajaan menghadapi bahaya, Putri Edea dengan zirah bermantranya, Lafranya, pergi untuk menemui temannya Lorand, Loch, dan Dean. Bersama, mereka bergabung dengan pasukan kerajaan menuju perang terakhir.
raw.pt: Durante a grande guerra com os deuses, Palmyna é invadida por tropas sob a liderança de Cardes, o Malévolo. Com o grande perigo que se aproxima do reino, a princesa Edea veste a armadura encantada Lafdranya e parte em uma jornada para encontrar seus companheiros Lorand, Loch e Dean. Juntos, eles se unem ao exército real, em direção à batalha.
raw.th: ระหว่างสงครามครั้งใหญ่กับเหล่าเทพเจ้า, ปาลมิน่าต้องทนทุกจากการรุกรานของกองทัพที่นำโดยคาเดสผู้ชั่วร้าย เมื่อราชอาณาจักรเผชิญกับอันตรายใหญ่หลวง, เจ้าหญิงอีเดียสวมใส่เกราะเวทมนตร์ ลาฟดรานยา และออกเดินทาง เพื่อพบกับเหล่าสหาย โลแลนด์, ล็อค, และ ดีน พวกเขาทั้งหมดเข้าร่วมกับกองทัพหลวงที่เหลือและมุ่งหน้าสู่สงครามครั้งสุดท้าย
raw.vi: Sau khi đánh bại Lucius, Paris mất đi thời gian cho bản thân tại Thư viện Đế chế khi Noel xuất hiện. Ông nói rằng có một nơi cô có thể tìm thấy con người thật của mình và do đó cô đã bắt đầu hành trình đến đó. Trên đường đi, cô gặp Người triệu hồi, đang ở khu vực này, tuy nhiên cô quyết định tiếp tục đi một mình. Tuy nhiên, một cuộc gặp gỡ bất ngờ khác đã xoay chuyển tình thế...

id: Setelah perang menegangkan, Edea dkk berhasil menyegel Cardes. Namun harga yang dibayar terlalu tinggi, karena Putri Edea jatuh tertidur abadi. Tersebar di berbagai arah akibat kekuatan Edea, teman-temannya mulai berkumpul kembali untuk menyelamatkannya. Ketiganya percaya, masih ada harapan.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_5000009_DESCRIPTION
desc: After a fierce battle, Edea and her friends succeed in sealing Cardes away. However, the price paid to accomplish this was far too high, as Princess Edea has fallen into a deep slumber. Having been scattered in different directions by Edea's powers, her friends begin regrouping in order to save her. The three believe there is still hope.

raw.en: After a fierce battle, Edea and her friends succeed in sealing Cardes away. However, the price paid to accomplish this was far too high, as Princess Edea has fallen into a deep slumber. Having been scattered in different directions by Edea's powers, her friends begin regrouping in order to save her. The three believe there is still hope.
raw.es: Luego de una lucha sin cuartel, Edea y sus amigos logran encerrar a Cardes. No obstante, el precio que tuvieron que pagar para hacerlo es demasiado alto, ya que la princesa Edea ha caído en un profundo sueño. Luego de haber tomado diferentes caminos gracias a los poderes de Edea, sus amigos comienzan a reagruparse para salvarla. Todos creen que aún hay esperanzas.
raw.id: Setelah perang menegangkan, Edea dkk berhasil menyegel Cardes. Namun harga yang dibayar terlalu tinggi, karena Putri Edea jatuh tertidur abadi. Tersebar di berbagai arah akibat kekuatan Edea, teman-temannya mulai berkumpul kembali untuk menyelamatkannya. Ketiganya percaya, masih ada harapan.
raw.pt: Depois de uma batalha feroz, Edea e seus companheiros consegue selar Cardes. Mas o preço pela conquista é alto demais, já que a princesa Edea caiu em um sono profundo. Enviados aos quatro ventos pelos poderes de Edea, seus amigos se reagrupam para salvá-la. Os três ainda têm esperança.
raw.th: หลังจากการต่อสู้อันดุเดือด, อีเดีย กับเพื่อนๆ ของเธอก็ประสบความสำเร็จในการผึกคาร์เดสไว้ อย่างไรก็ตาม, สิ่งที่พวกเขาต้องจ่ายเพื่อให้งานสำเร็จนั้นช่างมากมายเหลือเกิน เมื่อเจ้าหญิงอีเดียกลับต้องตกอยู่ในห้วงนิทรา และหลังจากที่ถูกแยกกันไปด้วยพลังของอีเดีย เพื่อนๆ ของเธอเริ่มกลับมารวมกลุ่มกันอีกครั้งเพื่อช่วยเหลือเธอ ทั้งสามคนเชื่อว่ายังคงมีความหวังอยู่
raw.vi: Trong cuộc đại chiến với các vị thần, Palmyna trải qua cuộc xâm chiếm của quân đội do Cardes Kẻ Xấu Xa chỉ huy. Khi vương quốc đối mặt với một nguy cơ khủng khiếp, Công chúa Edea mặc bộ giáp yểm phép thuật Lafdranya và bắt đầu hành trình đến gặp các bạn đồng hành Lorand, Loch và Dean. Họ cùng tham gia vào đội quân hoàng gia và tiến đến trận chiến cuối cùng.

id: Udara membawa napas berapi naga. Tidak diragukan segerombolan naga ada di dekat. Paling baik bergerak dengan diam untuk mencegah konfrontasi.

id: Suara aliran lava tak disangka enak didengar sampai raungan menulikan juga terdengar. Lebih pintar jika bersiap untuk perang.

desc: The sound of the lava flow is unexpectedly pleasant, until you suddenly hear a deafening roar. It might be smart to prepare for battle.

raw.th: ไม่คาดคิดมาก่อนว่าจะได้ยินเสียงลาวาไหล จนกระทั่งได้ยินเสียงคำราม คงจะดีถ้าเตรียมตัวต่อสู้เอาไว้
raw.vi: The sound of the lava flow is unexpectedly pleasant, until you suddenly hear a deafening roar. It might be smart to prepare for battle.

id: Jalan lava bak neraka ini sepertinya hampir selesai. Tapi hawa jahat masih berkeliaran. Apakah ini para pembunuh kiriman setan?
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_10204_DESCRIPTION
desc: This hell-like lava path seems to be almost over. However, menacing presences still lurk about. Could this be the demon's assassins?

raw.en: This hell-like lava path seems to be almost over. However, menacing presences still lurk about. Could this be the demon's assassins?

id: Pemandangan yang sangat berkesan tiba-tiba muncul. Laut merah dalam terbentang di depan mata. Warnanya membuatmu sadar bahwa kau berada di dunia lain.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_10210_DESCRIPTION
desc: Very impactful scenery suddenly comes into view. A deep red sea spreads before your eyes. Its hue makes you realize anew you're in another world.

raw.en: Very impactful scenery suddenly comes into view. A deep red sea spreads before your eyes. Its hue makes you realize anew you're in another world.
raw.es: Ante ti, te topas con una vista muy impactante. Delante de los ojos se abre un mar rojizo. Su tonalidad te recuerda que estás en otro mundo.
raw.id: Pemandangan yang sangat berkesan tiba-tiba muncul. Laut merah dalam terbentang di depan mata. Warnanya membuatmu sadar bahwa kau berada di dunia lain.
raw.pt: De repente, um cenário impactante surge à vista. Um mar de um vermelho profundo corre até o horizonte. A cor é um lembrete de que você está em outro mundo.

raw.vi: Very impactful scenery suddenly comes into view. A deep red sea spreads before your eyes. Its hue makes you realize anew you're in another world.

id: Meski laut ada warna merahnya, baunya tidak aneh sama sekali. Ini membuatmu merasa tidak nyaman dan sangat bingung.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_10211_DESCRIPTION
desc: Though the sea has a red tint to it, its smell is not strange at all. This disparity makes you uncomfortable and highly confuses you.

raw.en: Though the sea has a red tint to it, its smell is not strange at all. This disparity makes you uncomfortable and highly confuses you.

raw.id: Meski laut ada warna merahnya, baunya tidak aneh sama sekali. Ini membuatmu merasa tidak nyaman dan sangat bingung.

raw.th: แม้ทะเลจะมีสีแดง แต่กลิ่นก็ไม่ได้แปลกไปจากเดิมนัก มันทำให้รู้สึกไม่สู้ดีนัก และยังทำให้สับสน
raw.vi: Though the sea has a red tint to it, its smell is not strange at all. This disparity makes you uncomfortable and highly confuses you.

id: Laut berwarna matahari terbenam sudah pernah kau lihat sebelumnya. Tapi warna yang ini benar-benar berbeda. Kau mulai merasa sakit.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_10212_DESCRIPTION
desc: You've seen the sea dyed by the colors of the sunset before, but you're sure this water's hue is something entirely different. You start feeling sick.

raw.en: You've seen the sea dyed by the colors of the sunset before, but you're sure this water's hue is something entirely different. You start feeling sick.
raw.es: Ya has visto el mar teñido por los colores del sol, pero el tinte de esta agua es algo completamente diferente. Comienzas a sentirte mal.

raw.th: คุณเคยเห็นทะเลที่ถูกย้อมไปด้วยสีของพระอาทิตย์ตกดินมาก่อน แต่คุณมั่นใจว่าสีของน้ำที่นี่นั้นต่างออกไป มันทำให้คุณเริ่มรู้สึกป่วย
raw.vi: You've seen the sea dyed by the colors of the sunset before, but you're sure this water's hue is something entirely different. You start feeling sick.

id: Tak lama sebelum perang besar dengan para dewa, gadis muda dari Republik La Veda bernama Michele menyaksikan objek gelap aneh jatuh dari langit. name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_5000010_DESCRIPTION
desc: Not long before the great war with the gods, a young lady from the La Veda Republic called Michele witnessed a strange dark object fall from the sky. raw.es: ¿Qué habrá querido decir ese hombre? Dijo que odia a los invocadores de antaño... ¿Acaso será un invocador?
raw.id: Apa maksud perkataan pria itu? Dia bilang dia dendam pada Pemanggil Tua…jadi dia juga seorang Pemanggil?
raw.pt: O que será que aquele homem quis dizer? Ele disse que odeia os Invocadores Antigos...será que ele é um Invocador?
raw.th: ที่ชายผู้นั้นพูดมันหมายความว่ายังไง? เขาบอกว่าเขาโกรธแค้นซัมมอนเนอร์อาวุโส...หรือเขาก็เป็นซัมมอนเนอร์เหมือนกัน?
raw.vi: What could have that man meant to say? He said he resents the Summoners of Old...so could he be a Summoner himself?

id: Kristal berkilau di tengah kegelapan memang indah. Cantik dipandang, tapi apakah benar-benar berbahaya seperti kata orang itu?
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_10351_DESCRIPTION
desc: Crystals that sparkle amidst the darkness are beautiful. They are lovely to look at, but could they really be as dangerous as that man claims?

raw.en: Crystals that sparkle amidst the darkness are beautiful. They are lovely to look at, but could they really be as dangerous as that man claims?
raw.es: Los cristales que brillan en la oscuridad son hermosos. A la vista son fantásticos, ¿pero acaso serán tan peligrosos como afirmó ese hombre?
raw.id: Kristal berkilau di tengah kegelapan memang indah. Cantik dipandang, tapi apakah benar-benar berbahaya seperti kata orang itu?
raw.pt: Os cristais que brilham na escuridão são lindos. Eles são incríveis de se olhar, mas será que eles são perigosos ele diz?
raw.th: คริสตัลที่ส่องแสงท่ามกลางความมืดช่างงดงาม น่ามอง แต่มันจะอันตรายเหมือนกับที่เขาบอกไว้มั้ยนะ?
raw.vi: Crystals that sparkle amidst the darkness are beautiful. They are lovely to look at, but could they really be as dangerous as that man claims?

id: Sudah mendengar banyak legenda tentang kristal cantik yang memberikan kekuatan setan. Apakah ini salah satunya?
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_10352_DESCRIPTION
desc: You've heard many legends that tell of beautiful crystals which can grant demonic powers. Could these be the same crystals of lore?

raw.en: You've heard many legends that tell of beautiful crystals which can grant demonic powers. Could these be the same crystals of lore?
raw.es: Has oído muchas leyendas sobre cristales hermosos que otorgan poderes demoníacos. ¿Acaso se estarían refiriendo a estas piedras?
raw.id: Sudah mendengar banyak legenda tentang kristal cantik yang memberikan kekuatan setan. Apakah ini salah satunya?
raw.pt: Você ouviu muitas lendas que falam de cristais que dão poderes demoníacos. Será que estes cristais das histórias?
raw.th: คุณได้ยินตำนานมากมายที่กล่าวถึงคริสตัลอันงดงามที่มอบพลังปีศาจให้ หรือจะเป็นคริสตัลนี้?
raw.vi: You've heard many legends that tell of beautiful crystals which can grant demonic powers. Could these be the same crystals of lore?

id: Musuh di sini lebih kuat daripad adi luar. Apakah gara-gara kristal? Berhati-hatilah jangan sampai dirasuki.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_10353_DESCRIPTION
desc: The enemies here are stronger than those outside. Could it be the work of the crystals? Be careful not to get possessed by them.

raw.en: The enemies here are stronger than those outside. Could it be the work of the crystals? Be careful not to get possessed by them.
raw.es: Estos enemigos son más fuertes que los de afuera. ¿Acaso tendrán algo que ver los cristales? Ten cuidado de no caer bajo su yugo.
raw.id: Musuh di sini lebih kuat daripad adi luar. Apakah gara-gara kristal? Berhati-hatilah jangan sampai dirasuki.
raw.pt: Os inimigos daqui são mais fortes que os de fora. Será que é por causa dos cristais? Cuidado para não cair no encanto deles.
raw.th: ศัตรูที่นี่แข็งแกร่งกว่าด้านนอก หรือเป็นเพราะคริสตัล? ระวังอย่าให้มันเข้าครอบงำนะ
raw.vi: The enemies here are stronger than those outside. Could it be the work of the crystals? Be careful not to get possessed by them.

id: Kau tahu kau hampir keluar gua saat merasakan angin. Kastel tua tempat setan Melord menunggumu tidak terlalu jauh sekarang.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_10354_DESCRIPTION
desc: You know you're almost out of the cave when you feel a draft. The old castle where the demon Melord awaits shouldn't be too far now.

raw.en: You know you're almost out of the cave when you feel a draft. The old castle where the demon Melord awaits shouldn't be too far now.
raw.es: Sientes una corriente de aire y sabes que estás más cerca de la salida. El viejo castillo donde espera Melord no debería estar muy lejos.
raw.id: Kau tahu kau hampir keluar gua saat merasakan angin. Kastel tua tempat setan Melord menunggumu tidak terlalu jauh sekarang.
raw.pt: Você sabe que está quase fora da caverna quando sente algo. O velho castelo onde o demônio Melord aguarda não deve estar longe.
raw.th: รู้ว่ากำลังจะออกจากถ้ำได้แล้ว ปราสาทเก่าแก่ที่ปีศาจเมลอร์ดรออยู่นั้นอยู่ไม่ไกลจากที่นี่แล้ว
raw.vi: You know you're almost out of the cave when you feel a draft. The old castle where the demon Melord awaits shouldn't be too far now.

id: Kau tidak berkeberatan dipercayai mengurus Karl, tapi kau ingin mendiskusikan apa yang terjadi dengannya. Cari Karl begitu kau membereskan setan itu.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_10360_DESCRIPTION
desc: You don't mind being entrusted with Karl, but you want to discuss what's going on with him. Look for Karl as soon as you finish that demon.

raw.en: You don't mind being entrusted with Karl, but you want to discuss what's going on with him. Look for Karl as soon as you finish that demon.
raw.es: No te molesta tener que cuidar a Karl, pero te gustaría hablar sobre lo que está pasando con él. Mata a ese demonio y busca a tu amigo.
raw.id: Kau tidak berkeberatan dipercayai mengurus Karl, tapi kau ingin mendiskusikan apa yang terjadi dengannya. Cari Karl begitu kau membereskan setan itu.
raw.pt: Você não se importa de ficar com Karl, mas quer saber o que está acontecendo. Procure o Karl assim que acabar com aquele demônio.
raw.th: คุณเชื่อใจคาร์ล แต่ก็อยากรู้ว่าเกิดอะไรขึ้นกับเขา ต้องรีบหาตัวคาร์ลให้เจอโดยเร็วหลังกำจัดพวกปีศาจ
raw.vi: You don't mind being entrusted with Karl, but you want to discuss what's going on with him. Look for Karl as soon as you finish that demon.

id: Kastel berantakan. Berlalunya waktu, pengaruh setan busuk, dan murka Owen pasti menghancurkannya. Waktunya untuk menemukan setan itu.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_10361_DESCRIPTION
desc: The castle is in shambles. The passage of time, the influence of that rotting demon, and Owen's rage must have destroyed it. Time to find that demon.

raw.en: The castle is in shambles. The passage of time, the influence of that rotting demon, and Owen's rage must have destroyed it. Time to find that demon.
raw.es: El castillo está en ruinas. Debe haber caído por al paso del tiempo, la influencia de ese demonio podrido y la ira de Owen. Hora de hallar al demonio.
raw.id: Kastel berantakan. Berlalunya waktu, pengaruh setan busuk, dan murka Owen pasti menghancurkannya. Waktunya untuk menemukan setan itu.
raw.pt: O castelo está em pedaços. Deve ter sido um esforço conjunto do tempo, da influência daquele demônio podre e da ira de Owen. Hora de encontrar o demônio.
raw.th: ปราสาทเต็มไปด้วยความวุ่นวาย ทางผ่านของเวลา อิทธิพลจากพวกปีสาจ และความแค้นของโอเว่นที่ต้องทำลายมันให้ได้ ได้เวลาหาปีศาจตนนั้นแล้ว
raw.vi: The castle is in shambles. The passage of time, the influence of that rotting demon, and Owen's rage must have destroyed it. Time to find that demon.

id: Grahdens bilang seseorang di Ishgria mendendam pada Pemanggil Tua. Namun keberadaan makhluk semacam itu sendiri mengejutkan.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_10362_DESCRIPTION
desc: Grahdens mentioned that someone in Ishgria resents the Summoners of Old. However, the existence of such a creature is surprising in itself.

raw.en: Grahdens mentioned that someone in Ishgria resents the Summoners of Old. However, the existence of such a creature is surprising in itself.
raw.es: Grahdens mencionó que alguien en Ishgria odia a los invocadores de antaño. Sin embargo, el hecho de que exista una criatura así es sorprendente.
raw.id: Grahdens bilang seseorang di Ishgria mendendam pada Pemanggil Tua. Namun keberadaan makhluk semacam itu sendiri mengejutkan.
raw.pt: Grahdens falou que alguém em Ishgria odiava os Invocadores Antigos. Mas a existência de tal criatura é uma surpresa de verdade.
raw.th: กราห์เดนส์บอกว่ามีคนในอิชเกรียที่โกรธเคืองซัมมอนเนอร์อาวุโส อย่างไรก็ตาม การมีอยู่ของสิ่งที่มีวิตเหล่านั้นก็ช่างน่าแปลกใจ
raw.vi: Grahdens mentioned that someone in Ishgria resents the Summoners of Old. However, the existence of such a creature is surprising in itself.

id: Semakin dalam ke kastel, bau familier mulai tercium. Melord sepertinya dekat, jadi bergegaslah.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_10363_DESCRIPTION
desc: As you go deeper into the castle, a familiar stench hits your nostrils. Melord seems to be near, so hurry towards him.

raw.en: As you go deeper into the castle, a familiar stench hits your nostrils. Melord seems to be near, so hurry towards him.
raw.es: Conforme te adentras al castillo, un hedor familiar te azota la nariz. Parece que Melord está cerca. Apresúrate y alcánzalo.
raw.id: Semakin dalam ke kastel, bau familier mulai tercium. Melord sepertinya dekat, jadi bergegaslah.
raw.pt: Conforme você entra no castelo, você sente uma catinga familiar. Melord deve estar perto, então é melhor se apressar.
raw.th: ขณะที่คุณเดินลึกเข้าไปในปราสาท กลิ่นเหม็นก็ผ่านเข้ามาในรูจมูก เมลอรืดต้องอยู่แถวนี้แน่ รีบไปหาตัวเขากันเถอะ
raw.vi: As you go deeper into the castle, a familiar stench hits your nostrils. Melord seems to be near, so hurry towards him.

id: Lendir di tembok masih segar. Terdengar suara seperti Owen murka. Kau harus tetap maju.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_10364_DESCRIPTION
desc: The slime on the walls is still fresh. You hear something that sounds like Owen on a rampage. You have to keep moving forward.

raw.th: เมือกบนผนังยังใหม่อยู่เลย คุณได้ยินเสียงเหมือนโอเว่นกำลังโกรธแค้น จึงรีบมุ่งหน้าต่อไป
raw.vi: The slime on the walls is still fresh. You hear something that sounds like Owen on a rampage. You have to keep moving forward.

id: Melord, mantan murid Lucius, kini hidup sebagai setan yang terkorupsi miasma dan kristal setan. Pastikan kau benar-benar sehat untuk pertarungan ini.
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_10365_DESCRIPTION
desc: Melord, Lucius's former disciple, now lives as a demon corrupted by the miasma and demon crystals. Make sure you're in top shape for this fight.

raw.en: Melord, Lucius's former disciple, now lives as a demon corrupted by the miasma and demon crystals. Make sure you're in top shape for this fight.

raw.pt: Melord, um velho discípulo de Lucius, agora vive como um Demônio corrupto próximo ao miasma e cristais demoníacos. Certifique-se de estar em forma para esta luta.

raw.vi: Melord, Lucius's former disciple, now lives as a demon corrupted by the miasma and demon crystals. Make sure you're in top shape for this fight.

id: Melord ada di makam kapal yang membusuk! Kini murid Dewa Tersegel mengejarmu untuk melakukan perintah tuannya!
name: MST_DUNGEONS_MISSION_10370_DESCRIPTION
desc: You find Melord in a graveyard of rotting ships. Now the disciple of the Sealed God comes after you to do the bidding of his master!

raw.id: Melord ada di makam kapal yang membusuk! Kini murid Dewa Tersegel mengejarmu untuk melakukan perintah tuannya!

raw.vi: You find Melord in a graveyard of rotting ships. Now the disciple of the Sealed God comes after you to do the bidding of his master!
